## Description

Linearizes non-linear implied volatility smile evolution using Koopman operator observable dictionaries, predicting intra-day volatility surface shifts for options arbitrage.

## Where it may fit

Options market making, implied volatility smile mispricing, volatility derivatives trading.

## Vehicles

Volatility Arbitrage Funds, Options Market Making Desks.

## Required data

Intraday option chain quotes, implied volatility surface matrices, underlying spot quotes.

## Caveats

Observable dictionary function expansion requires regularization to prevent overfitting across strikes and expirations.
